script: A portfolio is your proof of skill. Clients buy trust, and a portfolio is how you show it. You do not need paid work to make one. You need six to eight strong samples that look like real jobs. Start by choosing three imaginary or real small businesses. A bakery, a tuition centre and a clinic are common and easy to imagine. For each business, create the kind of work it would really need. That might be a flyer, a set of Instagram posts, a reel cover, or a product list. If you know a local shop owner, ask whether you may redesign one of their posts for free, in exchange for a review and a credit. Get written permission before you publish their name or logo. Never use a sample you did not create, and never claim a result that did not happen.
